newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon had strong demand, sees better H2.
newsitem.headline: Benefon had strong demand, sees better H2.

text.p: Finnish mobile phones maker Benefon Oy said in a statement on Wednesday that demand for its products had remained strong in the summer, and the latter part of 1996 was expected to be clearly better than the early part.
"Demand for Benefon's products has remained strong over the summer and the latter part of the year it expected to be clearly better than the early part of the year," Benefon said.

Benefon's January-June profit before extraordinary items and taxes fell to 17.0 million markka from 35.7 million. Benefon said the development of its first GSM product had been slower than expected and no schedule for the launch could yet be given.
